classification: Explicit locally amended fixtures; not unmodified upstream Test262. Original vendor files and native baseline results remain unchanged.

authorities.section: Use of the IANA Time Zone Database; country-preserving identifier requirement
authorities.authority_note: Recorded observation; the repository does not currently pin ECMA-402.

corrections.reason: The 2017 test appends implicit arguments to parameterNames. The pinned algorithm leaves formal paramNames unchanged and appends implicit arguments to paramBindings, allowing the Annex B copy. Preserve pre-block/in-block assertions, correct all three post-block assertions, and add an explicit-formal control.

The default tzdb Link crosses from UM to US, conflicting with ECMA-402 country preservation. Move only Johnston into the existing acceptance/name-preservation group; retain all valid alias equality and offset assertions. The backzone-Zone/algorithm-Link hole remains documented; this correction does not claim to resolve it.

The pending SpiderMonkey fixture expects recursive block-labelled lexical declarations and outer copies under labels. The pinned LexicallyScopedDeclarations and Annex B direct-declaration rules distinguish these cases. Preserve all13 original expect* calls, syntax checks and modes; explicitly test ReferenceError before/after a chained block label, direct-label initialization before/after evaluation inside its scope, and ReferenceError only after leaving a direct-labelled block/CaseBlock. The original fixture and V8 disagreement remain retained in evidence.
